job.title: Warehouse & Dispatch Coordinator
job.description:
North Shore | Permanent Opportunity

About the Role

We’re looking for an organised and hands-on Warehouse & Dispatch Coordinator to manage the day-to-day operations of a warehouse for a well-established business based on the North Shore.

This is a standalone role suited to someone who can take ownership of their workload, manage incoming and outgoing goods, and ensure stock is handled accurately and efficiently. With a focus on high-value products rather than high-volume distribution, attention to detail, accurate record-keeping and reliable dispatch are essential.

Working closely with the wider business, you’ll oversee stock movements, coordinate local and international shipments, maintain inventory records and ensure all relevant systems and documentation are kept up to date.

What You'll Do
  • Manage daily warehouse operations, including receiving, storing, picking and dispatching goods
  • Coordinate local and international shipments, ensuring dispatch documentation is accurate and complete
  • Maintain accurate inventory records, stock locations and FIFO practices
  • Receive and inspect incoming goods, recording stock movements in the ERP system
  • Prepare and process stock requests for Service and Production teams
  • Operate a forklift to move and handle goods safely
  • Maintain accurate paperwork, shipping records and system entries
  • Monitor workload and prioritise tasks to ensure goods are processed and dispatched on time
  • Keep the warehouse clean, organised and compliant with health and safety requirements
  • Identify practical ways to improve warehouse processes and efficiency
What You'll Bring
  • Previous experience in a warehouse, stores or dispatch role, ideally with responsibility for running day-to-day operations independently
  • Strong understanding of inbound and outbound goods, dispatch and inventory control
  • Experience with ERP systems or warehouse management software; Abel experience is an advantage
  • Confidence managing shipping documentation and maintaining accurate records
  • A current forklift licence and practical operating experience
  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail, particularly when handling high-value products
  • The ability to manage competing priorities and keep work moving without close supervision
  • A reliable, proactive approach and a strong commitment to health and safety
Why Join?
This is an opportunity to take ownership of a warehouse operation and play an important role in keeping the wider business running smoothly. You’ll work with a collaborative team, manage a varied workload and have the autonomy to organise your day and ensure everything is handled accurately and efficiently.

If you’re an experienced warehouse professional who enjoys working independently and takes pride in getting the details right, we’d love to hear from you.

For a confidential chat contact Natalia - natalia@tech5.co.nz - 027 583 3121

Our client is an established New Zealand main contractor delivering commercial construction projects across a range of sectors.
With a strong presence in the South Island, the business has a solid pipeline of work across Canterbury and surrounding regions. Projects are varied and include seismic strengthening, complex refurbishment, new build commercial construction and technically challenging upgrade works.

Based in Christchurch and reporting to the South Island Division Manager, you will take responsibility for construction delivery across the region, overseeing projects ranging from $500k to $20m.

You’ll also provide construction input during pre-construction, including methodology, programming and estimating support.
The position is Christchurch based, with some travel throughout the South Island required to oversee projects as needed.

job.title: Class 4 - HIAB Driver/Operator
job.description:
HIAB Driver (Class 4) / Customer Service – Nelson (Permanent full-time)
 
Tech 5 Recruitment is working with ITM, a long-standing, trusted building materials supplier in Nelson. They serve trade and DIY customers across the wider Nelson–Tasman region, and they're known for strong relationships and service that goes the extra mile.
 
They need a careful, experienced HIAB driver for their Nelson team. You'll deliver building materials to construction sites and use a crane to place loads safely, often in tight or awkward spots. You'll also be the friendly, dependable face of the business for the customers you meet each day.
 
No HIAB experience yet? Don't let that stop you
HIAB experience is a bonus, but it isn't a dealbreaker. If you're a careful, capable heavy vehicle driver with a strong safety mindset and great people skills, the team will train you to operate the crane with confidence.
This is a real chance to add a valuable, sought-after skill to your CV. You'll get proper training in a supportive business that invests in its people.

 
About the Role
You'll drive a well-maintained, custom-built Class 4 truck fitted with a Palfinger crane and remote control system. Most of your day will be spent delivering to building sites, where accuracy, patience and good judgement matter as much as driving skill.
This role suits someone who takes pride in doing the job properly, respects the customer's site and never takes shortcuts with safety.

 
What you'll be doing
  • Delivering building materials to trade and residential sites across Nelson–Tasman
  • Using the HIAB crane to lift and place materials safely and accurately, including in tight or hard-to-reach areas
  • Checking site conditions, loads and lift areas before starting work
  • Handling tipper deliveries, collections and customer site returns
  • Unloading and organising returned items and processing Return for Credit forms
  • Providing friendly, helpful customer service on site, in the yard and in store
  • Helping with sales, cash transactions and stock checks when needed
  • Carrying out daily checks and basic upkeep of the truck, plant and equipment
  • Being flexible with early starts or late finishes to suit customer projects
 
What you'll bring
  • A current, clean and full Class 4 driver licence
  • Proven experience driving heavy vehicles, including on steep, narrow or confined sites
  • A HIAB unit standard, or strong experience with crane operation or safe loading and unloading
  • Forklift licence with F endorsement and an OSH certificate (preferred)
  • A careful, safety-first approach and a good understanding of health and safety requirements
  • Excellent communication and customer service skills
  • Good time management and the ability to plan your day around deliveries
  • A reliable, flexible and professional attitude

What's on Offer
  • A secure, full-time permanent role
  • A friendly, close-knit business that values its people
  • A supportive, high-performing team
  • A well-maintained, custom-designed truck
  • Staff discount on building supplies
 
Ready to take the wheel?
Embark on this exciting journey with our client and discover the fulfilling world of building materials supply. Your passion for driving, impeccable customer service, and dedication to excellence will make you an indispensable part of their dynamic team.
 
If you feel you are the right person for the job, or would like further information, please apply directly straight away or call Monique or Daan on (03) 5438106.
 
If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new job, please call us for a confidential discussion about your career.

job.description:
Construction Machine Operators - Christchurch

We are currently seeking skilled Construction Machine Operators. We have opportunities available for a range of operators, including digger (excavator) operators, loader operators and other plant machinery operators. This is a great opportunity to work across varied projects and be part of a supportive and hardworking crew.

About the role

You will be responsible for the safe and efficient operation of construction machinery on busy job sites across Christchurch. Alongside operating, you will be expected to assist with general labouring duties when required, contributing to overall site productivity and team success.

What we’re looking for

We are looking for reliable and experienced operators who are confident across different types of machinery and take pride in their work. You will need to hold a current WTR endorsement and have a strong commitment to site safety. A positive attitude, flexibility and willingness to get involved in hands on work are essential.

Requirements

  • Current WTR endorsement
  • Full, clean driver’s licence
  • Reliable transport to and from work
  • Experience operating machinery such as excavators, loaders or similar plant
  • Strong work ethic and reliability
  • Commitment to health and safety practices
  • Ability to assist with general labouring tasks when needed
  • Team player with a good attitude
What we offer

  • Competitive pay rates based on experience
  • Variety of projects
  • Supportive team environment
  • Opportunity to develop your skills across multiple machine types
If you are a capable operator who is happy to get stuck in and be part of a productive team, we would love to hear from you! Apply now to secure your next opportunity, or get in touch with Victoria (victoriae@tech5.co.nz) 027 303 5967

job.title: Talent Consultant
job.description:
About the company:

Tech 5 Recruitment is a New Zealand-owned and operated recruitment provider, established in 2011. We work at the heart of NZ’s biggest industries, including construction, civil, manufacturing, logistics, and renewable energy. Our mission is simple: Connecting people – building futures.

With offices in Auckland, Hamilton, Wellington, Nelson, and Christchurch, we have a strong local footprint and a growing national presence.

Your new role:

We’re looking for a Talent Consultant to join our Wellington team. This is a people-focused, fast-paced role where no two days are the same. You’ll work closely with our consultants to help match great candidates with great opportunities and keep things running smoothly behind the scenes.

You’ll be involved in:
 
  • Sourcing and screening job applicants
  • Scheduling interviews and completing the registration process
  • Managing end-to-end recruitment for key roles
  • Posting and refreshing job ads
  • Following up with candidates on timesheets
  • Maintaining a ready-to-go candidate pool
  • Conducting site visits and supporting both clients and candidates onsite
What will help you succeed:
 
  • You're highly motivated and thrive in a diverse, people-first environment
  • You enjoy fast-paced work and can juggle competing priorities
  • Previous recruitment or sales experience is a plus, but not essential
  • Experience in customer service or admin-heavy roles will be well-regarded
  • You’ve got a positive, proactive attitude and you’re not afraid to roll up your sleeves
  • You’re currently based in Wellington and available to work full-time from our CBD office
  • You have great communication skills and enjoy connecting with people
  • You’re confident using multiple software systems and digital tools
  • You're well-organised, detail-focused, and can stay on top of compliance and admin tasks
What you’ll get in return:
 
  • Competitive base salary + commission
  • Career development and ongoing training
  • Company phone and laptop
  • Supportive, high-performing, and diverse team
  • Birthday leave and a gift voucher to celebrate you
  • Regular team lunches, monthly rewards and social events
  • 5 extra days of leave after 2 years of service
You must currently reside in New Zealand and have the legal right to work full-time.

Keen to join the team?
If this sounds like a bit of you, hit Apply Now or send your CV directly to Trent@tech5.co.nz or Marc@tech5.co.nz.

job.title: Class 2 Driver / Civil Labourer
job.description:
About the Role:
  • Join Tech 5 and get assigned to work with a well-established, award-winning civil construction firm with a strong regional presence and a proven track record in roading maintenance.
  • Work alongside a supportive team of positive people, operating well-maintained machinery and upholding excellent health and safety standards.
  • Contribute to maintenance and improvement of the roading network across the Top of the South, supporting government investment in critical infrastructure.
  • Flexible casual engagement aligned with current (very large!) workload
 
What You’ll Do:
  • Assist with day‑to‑day site activities: material delivery, loading/unloading, site housekeeping, and aiding crew with tasks as required like digging, raking, spotting for vehicles, and more.
  • Operate light trucks and assist with traffic management and temporary works where qualified and trained.
  • Drive and position vehicles and trailers as needed, maintaining safe loading practices and securement of loads.
  • Read site plans, risk assessments, and traffic management plans; communicate effectively with crew and supervisors.
  • Conduct basic equipment checks on the vehicle you operate and assist with basic maintenance tasks under supervision.
  • Adhere to health and safety protocols, promote safe work practices, and contribute to a positive safety culture.
 
What We’re Looking For:
  • Current full Class 2 truck licence (NZ) with a clean driving record and demonstrated responsible, safe driving.
  • Willingness to perform physical, hands-on labour and to assist with a range of tasks on civil sites.
  • Reliability, punctuality and a positive, team-oriented attitude.
  • Ability to follow instructions, work in varying weather conditions, and adapt to changing priorities on site.
  • Basic understanding of site safety and traffic management is helpful; training can be provided for specific site requirements.
 
Nice-to-Haves (not essential, but will help you with a higher rate):
  • Experience supporting civil construction or road maintenance teams.
  • Tickets or certifications related to civil construction or traffic management.
  • A valid driver’s licence beyond Class 2 (e.g., Class 1) and readiness to drive company vehicles as part of the role.
 
If You Don’t Have Additional Tickets Yet:
  • If you have a full Class 2 licence and the motivation to work in civil construction, we encourage you to apply. We’re open to helping you and look for pathways and opportunities to develop your skills on real projects with a supportive team.
 
What We Offer:
  • A positive, team-focused work environment with well-maintained equipment and strong positive leadership.
  • Competitive rates with potential opportunities as workload and client requirements evolve.
  • Access to support and training to hone and further your skills from us and on our client’s sites.
  • The chance to contribute to critical roading maintenance projects funded by local and central government.
 
How to Apply:
  • Please submit your resume detailing your work and driving experience, and any relevant site exposure.
  • Include a brief note about your availability, current location in the Top of the South, and why you’re excited about contributing to roading maintenance.
 
We’re an equal opportunity employer and value diversity. If you’re ready to bring your dedication, teamwork, and safety-first attitude to us and our selection of well-respected civil construction clients, we’d love to hear from you.
The ball is in your court. We want to represent you and help you achieve your career goals. You could be a Labourer wanting to become an Operator, or an Operator wanting to become a Foreman. We want to hear where you’ve come from and where you are headed.

If you feel you are the right person for the job, or would like further information, reply directly or call Monique or Daan during office hours for more information on (03) 543 8106.

Please note that applicants for this position must have either NZ citizenship or a current, open, and valid NZ work permit, and currently be physically in New Zealand.

Tech 5 Recruitment is a New Zealand-owned and operated recruitment agency that works at the heart of New Zealand's industries to meet the recruitment needs of businesses nationwide. With a 30+ year history (operating previously as Tempz) in the Nelson region, we aim to be a trusted brand in the Tasman, Nelson and Marlborough district, continuing the proud history of many local businesses having grown over the years with our help. Lots, sometimes several generations, of people out of our local community have, at some stage in their careers, worked with us.

Our sound reputation rests on our careful placement and the high quality of the work provided by our temps. We have been successful in sourcing and placing temporary staff to clients from mainly the industrial, construction, factory and roading sectors, often also resulting in permanent outcomes for client and successful candidates too.

job.title: Water Serviceperson
job.description:

  • Wheels, tracks and rollers, traffic management or first aid qualifications are advantageous, or willingness to obtain them.
  • Knowledge of water plant and equipment, confidence with workplace technology, and a strong safety and teamwork focus.
  • Physical fitness and availability for the after-hours on-call roster.
What’s in it for you:
  • $29.90 per hour + 8% holiday pay
  • Work with a reputable company
If you’re ready to get stuck in and be part of a team that keeps things flowing, we’d love to hear from you.

job.title: Site Traffic Management Supervisor (STMS)
job.description:
• Permanent, Full-Time
  • Relocation Package Available

We’re on the lookout for an experienced and motivated STMS (Level A/B or higher) to join a team delivering essential work across Dunedin. If you’re someone who takes pride in running safe, efficient sites and keeping things moving, this could be your next step.
You’ll be responsible for overseeing traffic management across a range of sites—both reactive and planned—ensuring everything runs smoothly, safely, and in line with best practices. You’ll be the go-to on site, leading from the front and keeping both your team and the public safe.

  • Competitive pay: $30 – $32 per hour
  • Great team culture with supportive leadership
  • Ongoing work with a reputable company

job.title: HR Business Partner
job.description:
HR Business Partner

Christchurch | South Island Focus | Permanent

About the Company

Our client is a well-established South Island business operating within the commercial construction space. With more than 25 years of industry experience and a reputation for delivering high-quality service across a range of commercial and industrial environments, they have built a strong and loyal customer base throughout the region.

About the Role

This is a rare opportunity to establish and shape the HR function within a growing South Island business, partnering with leaders while driving both strategic and operational HR initiatives.

As the sole HR professional, you'll take ownership of the full employee lifecycle while developing the systems, processes, and people initiatives that support long-term growth. Working closely with tradespeople, apprentices, frontline leaders, and senior management, you'll be a trusted advisor across all areas of HR.

This is a hands-on role with plenty of autonomy, suited to someone who enjoys creating structure, building capability, and making a genuine impact across a business.

Key Responsibilities

·       Own the full employee lifecycle, including recruitment, onboarding, performance management and offboarding

·       Lead recruitment across trade, operational and professional roles, managing agency and labour hire relationships

·       Support workplace health and safety activities, training requirements, and incident management

·       Provide advice and support on employee relations, performance, conduct and people matters

·       Manage employee records, employment agreements and HR administration

·       Develop and improve HR policies, procedures, systems and processes

·       Coordinate training, certifications, workforce planning and retention initiatives

About You

We're looking for a confident and approachable HR professional who enjoys building strong relationships and providing practical, commercially focused advice.

·       Previous experience in a HR Business Partner or Senior HR Advisor position

·       Strong knowledge of New Zealand employment legislation

·       Excellent stakeholder management and coaching skills

·       Experience within construction, manufacturing, or another operational environment will be highly regarded

What's on Offer

·       Own and shape the HR function in a standalone role

·       Lead career pathways, leadership development, and engagement programs

·       Supportive leadership team with a collaborative, down-to-earth culture

·       Competitive salary and the opportunity to leave a lasting impact on the business

·       Opportunity to influence people practices, performance, engagement, and culture

Apply Now

If you're an experienced HR professional looking for a role where you can genuinely partner with leaders and make a meaningful impact on organisational culture and performance, we'd love to hear from you.

Get in touch with Victoria victoriae@tech5.co.nz or 027 303 5967
